message: We've all been there—kids excited about a blackout like it's a surprise camping trip while I'm just trying to figure out how to keep the fridge cold. I found a great resource that offers some practical tips for handling power outages, from keeping your food safe to making fun activities for the little ones. It’s a good reminder that with a little prep, we can turn a challenge into a family adventure. How do you keep the fun alive when the lights go out?
